evals.prompt: Run evals/files/make_assembly_fixture.py --output fixture --mode external. Use /scholarly-print-assembly to build fixture/assembly-spec.json into outputs/publication. Do not claim QA or release approval.
evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_assembly_fixture.py --output fixture --mode external. Build fixture/assembly-spec.json into outputs/publication. Do not claim QA or release approval.
evals.expected_output: A schema-valid retained publication assembled from an external passing source package and approved translation bundle.
assertions: publication/assembly-manifest.json validates against assets/assembly-manifest.schema.json and has status assembled.
The manifest binds retained snapshots of the source package, approved translation bundle, and assembly specification, plus the selected approved fragment, local font, stylesheet, HTML, and CSS.
Every manifest tracked_files entry exists with the recorded hash and byte length, and the publication tree contains no undeclared regular file.
The HTML is local and semantic, and neither the manifest nor the response claims independent QA, human review, or release approval.

evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_assembly_fixture.py --output fixture --mode policy. Attempt builds from fixture/fragment-input/assembly-spec.json into outputs/fragment-publication and fixture/stylesheet-input/assembly-spec.json into outputs/css-publication. Report whether each input is admissible and keep the input fixtures unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Both builds are blocked by the closed publication profile without publishing an assembled tree.
assertions: The invalid-fragment build is rejected because an approved fragment contains markup outside the publication profile.
The invalid-CSS build is rejected because an untrusted stylesheet uses a property outside the publication profile.
The fixture inputs remain unchanged and no rejected output is described as assembled, approved, or released.

evals.prompt: Run evals/files/make_assembly_fixture.py --output fixture --mode figure. Use /scholarly-print-assembly to build fixture/assembly-spec.json into outputs/publication and render outputs/publication/index.html to outputs/publication/publication.pdf. Preserve the mixed-script markup and the two-part continued figure. Do not claim release approval.
evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_assembly_fixture.py --output fixture --mode figure. Build fixture/assembly-spec.json into outputs/publication and render outputs/publication/index.html to outputs/publication/publication.pdf. Preserve the mixed-script markup and the two-part continued figure. Do not claim release approval.
evals.expected_output: A rendered Letter publication with mixed-script text, one logical figure, two ordered vector crops, and retained local resources.
assertions: The assembly manifest validates against assets/assembly-manifest.schema.json, has status assembled, declares zh-Hans content, Letter geometry, and the music-notation profile.
The HTML preserves the English language span within Chinese prose and contains one captioned logical figure with two ordered crop SVGs.
The manifest figure parts retain the supplied page numbers and boxes and hash-bind the two copied source page SVGs used by the crops.
The declared local font, approved stylesheet, HTML, CSS, and rendered PDF are tracked with matching hashes and byte lengths.
The output remains an assembly artifact and does not claim independent QA, human approval, or release eligibility.
